overall_summary: The channel shows a strong outlier in family relationship dynamics (husband-wife topic reaching 1,666 views), while general family and self-motivation videos hover between 100-300 views. Data size is small, so confidence is low, and we must lean into relationship dynamics while testing a core heartbreak topic.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife emotional video (or5gtaBpRVY) achieved 1,666 views, significantly outperforming sibling and parent videos.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more narratives on complex everyday relationship realities and marital understanding.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos addressing subtle behavioral truths like communication gaps (rl_ycNbXZ_g) and apologies (NO5fdHLxFL4) perform stably above 250-300 views.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific, highly recognizable micro-moments rather than broad emotional statements.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister/Brother emotional videos (jfmMztnam_A, fAAoIQCRMXU) had low traction (18 and 135 views respectively).
weak_patterns.action: Reduce broad filler content on siblings unless tied to a unique situational conflict.
